units.v: m/s (air speed at the person; NOT 10 m wind)
units.p_a_kpa: kPa (water vapour partial pressure actually used by the model)
units.clo: clo (static intrinsic clothing insulation; 1 clo = 0.155 m2K/W)
units.a_p: fraction of body surface covered by reflective clothing (0 for ordinary clothing)
units.f_r: 2004: emissivity of reflective clothing; 2023 (pythermalcomfort): reflection coefficient (uses 1-f_r)
units.walk_sp: m/s (0 => not entered; estimated from met internally)
units.outputs.d_lim_t_re: min from START OF THIS CALL until t_re >= 38 degC (duration if not reached)
units.outputs.d_lim_loss_50/95: min from START OF THIS CALL until sweat_loss_g >= D_max (duration if not reached; x0.6 if drink=0)
units.outputs.sweat_rate_watt: W/m2 predicted sweat rate at the last minute
units.outputs.sweat_loss_g: g cumulative water loss (sweat + respiratory) for the whole body, incl. carried-over load

conventions.outputs: unrounded IEEE-754 doubles from pythermalcomfort 4.8.1 (limit_inputs=False, round_output=False)
conventions.outputs_rounded_pythermalcomfort: numpy.around (round-half-even on the binary value), 1 dp (t_sk_t_cr_wg 2 dp). Do NOT test a port against these with Math.round; compare unrounded values.
conventions.validity: ISO 7933 Annex A Table A.1 limits as implemented by pythermalcomfort 4.8.1 (inclusive bounds). If failing is non-empty, pythermalcomfort with limit_inputs=True returns NaN for every output.
conventions.variants: reference-implementation results for alternative, documented choices (not pythermalcomfort).

recommended_tolerances_for_port.note: observed reference-vs-pythermalcomfort max relative diff is recorded in self_checks; D_lim must match exactly unless d_lim_margins shows |margin| < 1e-9

7933-2023.WARNING: a_p=0.54 with f_r=0.42 gives clothing emissivity 0.759 (partly reflective); use a_p=0 for ordinary clothing
